title: Attention Is All You Need
subtitle: The Transformer architecture
summary: A Transformer-based encoder–decoder architecture uses multi-head attention, feed-forward blocks and positional encoding instead of recurrence in sequence transduction.
takeaway: NO RECURRENCE. ALL ATTENTION. Sequence positions interact by attention and support parallel training.
method: Six encoder layers and six decoder layers; scaled dot-product self-attention, masked decoder attention and encoder–decoder cross-attention.
limitations: Full dense self-attention has quadratic pairwise token interactions, and the decoder still generates tokens autoregressively.

source.version: NeurIPS 2017 proceedings, Table 2 (EN–FR 41.0; later arXiv revisions may differ)
source.citation: Vaswani, A., et al. (2017). Attention Is All You Need. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30.
